facts.fact: The Ministry of Energy, Petroleum and Mines held the official launch workshop on 17 March 2026 for a complaints management mechanism for the oil and gas sector, with reception channels WhatsApp, e-mail, a web form and physical boxes.

systems.platform: WhatsApp, e-mail, web form, physical boxes
systems.owner: Ministère de l'Energie, du Pétrole et des Mines (DGCSO)
